final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which deletes any character outside `a-z0-9`, accented letters included. I didn't touch `vendor/`. The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`, where `postSlug` now strips the accent marks from the title before passing it to `slugify`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs still drop accented letters. I left it alone because you only asked about blog posts. If you want it fixed too, it needs the same change.
